lines: 一只僵尸，翻不过这堵八米高的墙。
One zombie can't climb an eight-metre wall.
可几千只僵尸，会把彼此当成梯子。
But a few thousand will use each other as a ladder.
《僵尸世界大战》里，尸潮就是这样叠成人山，翻进城里的。|每一只都在找路、推挤、攀爬，|游戏要怎么同时算这么多个？
In World War Z, that's how the horde piles into a mountain and spills over.|Every one of them is pathing, shoving and climbing.|How does a game compute that many at once?
这一期，我们从《守望先锋》的 ECS 讲起。
This episode starts with the ECS behind Overwatch.
最直觉的写法，是给每只僵尸一个对象：|位置、速度、血量、动画，再写一个 update。
The intuitive way is one object per zombie:|position, velocity, health, animation, plus an update method.
可这些对象散落在内存各处，|CPU 每次整块读进 64 字节，|大部分都用不上。
But those objects are scattered across memory.|The CPU always fetches 64 bytes at a time,|and most of them go unused.
我在这台电脑上测了一下：|一百万个对象，光是挪一步就要 37 毫秒，|超过了一整帧的时间。
I measured it on this machine:|just moving a million objects one step takes 37 milliseconds,|more than a whole frame.
《守望先锋》用的是另一种架构。|这是首席玩法程序员 Tim Ford 在 GDC 2017 的演讲：
Overwatch uses a different architecture.|Here is lead gameplay programmer Tim Ford at GDC 2017:

credit: GDC 2017 · Timothy Ford · Overwatch Gameplay Architecture and Netcode
lines: 实体其实只是一个 ID，对应一组组件
An entity is really just an ID that corresponds to a collection of components.
组件存储游戏状态，没有行为
Components store game state and have no behaviors.
系统拥有行为，不存储游戏状态
Systems have behaviors and store no game state.
组件里没有函数，系统里没有字段。
Components have no functions; systems have no fields.
每个系统只关心几种组件：|挂机检测只处理同时拥有连接、输入和统计的实体，|AI 机器人没有连接组件，自然就被跳过。
Each system only cares about a few components:|the AFK check runs on entities that have a connection, input and stats;|an AI bot has no connection, so it's simply skipped.
《守望先锋》客户端大约有 46 个系统、103 种组件。|对他们来说，最大的好处是控制复杂度。
The Overwatch client has about 46 systems and 103 component types.|For them, the big win was keeping complexity under control.
实体多到上万时，ECS 还有另一个好处：|同一种组件，可以紧挨着存成一列数组。
Once there are tens of thousands of entities, ECS has another payoff:|each component type can sit packed in a single array.
系统从头到尾扫一遍，|读进来的每个字节都有用。|同样一百万个，只要 3.8 毫秒，快了将近十倍。
A system sweeps it from start to end,|and every byte it fetches gets used.|The same million entities take 3.8 milliseconds, almost ten times faster.
可光跑得快还不够：|一万只僵尸要是各自算一遍寻路，还是算不过来。
Speed alone isn't enough:|ten thousand zombies each running their own pathfinding is still too much.
办法是流场：|从目标出发，把整条街的距离算一遍，|每个格子存一个指向目标的箭头。
The answer is a flow field:|compute the distance to the goal across the whole street once,|and every cell stores an arrow pointing the way.
每只僵尸只读脚下的那一个箭头。|地图只算一次，僵尸再多也不怕。
Each zombie reads only the arrow under its feet.|The map is solved once, no matter how many zombies there are.
人山是怎么叠起来的？|每一步，先数一数每个格子里有几只僵尸，|和上一期鱼群用的是同一张网格。
So how does the mountain form?|Every step, count the zombies in each cell,|the same grid trick the flocks used.
格子越挤，僵尸就站得越高；|被墙挡住的，会爬到同伴身上，|坡越堆越高，最后漫过墙头。
The more crowded the cell, the higher a zombie stands;|those blocked by the wall climb onto the others,|and the slope rises until it spills over the top.
据 Game Informer 报道，|《僵尸世界大战》为尸潮专门写了 Swarm 引擎，|同屏最多约五百只。
According to Game Informer,|World War Z's Swarm Engine was built for the hordes,|handling up to about five hundred zombies on screen.
它内部怎么实现并没有公开，|这里演示的是一种常见思路。
Its internals aren't public;|what you see here is one common approach.
整个尸潮就是七个系统，每帧按顺序跑一遍：|生成、计数、流场、攀爬、移动、回收、动画。
The whole horde is seven systems, run in order every frame:|spawn, count, flow, climb, move, recycle, animate.
八千一百九十二只僵尸，|每一只都只是几列数组里的一行。
Eight thousand one hundred ninety-two zombies,|each just one row across a few arrays.
每只僵尸，都要转身朝向目标。|可如果要转向的，是一百万块太阳能板呢？
Every zombie turns to face its goal.|But what if what needs turning is a million solar panels?
下一期：《戴森球计划》，|让无数块太阳能板一起追着太阳转。
Next time: Dyson Sphere Program,|and countless solar panels tracking the sun together.
而这一切，还得从一只僵尸说起。
And all of it starts, once again, with a single zombie.
